snippet.title: VOID - Eight Lives Left (Offiical Steam Trailer)
snippet.description:
Finally the game page is available on Steam so you can Wishlist it! 
Set in the late 1800s, early 1900s. Play as a cat who wants to be fed (again) so badly that he breaks the laws of time and space to do so.

Go wishlist the game on Steam or support it on Patreon via the linktree (which has everything VOID on it) here: https://linktr.ee/VOID.developer

Support the creation of the project on Patreon:
https://www.patreon.com/c/EightLivesLeft

#indiedeveloper #catgame #cats #murdermystery #noai
